summary: Component T5 of the plan docs/plans/latency-gates-2026-10.md (section 4.1, decisions D3 and D5, ADR-0144). The tested window is the last 10 main runs, and the baseline is the 30 good main runs before it. A breach needs a median more than 15% above the baseline and an increase above 60 s on ubuntu or 90 s on macOS. A one-sided exact Mann-Whitney U test must give p < 0.01.
